name: Sassanid Archaeological Landscape of Fars Region
description: In the hills and plains of southeastern Fars Province, eight ruined sites trace the Sassanian Empire (224–658 CE) from its beginning to its end. They are grouped around Firuzabad, Bishapur and Sarvestan. Highlights include Ardashir Papakan's round founding capital and Shapur I's city, with fortifications and palaces that were built to follow the natural lie of the land.
